children: Kuwait-founded COFE Tech has secured funding from Saudi Aramco’s Wa’ed Ventures and other investors ahead of its initial public offering (IPO).

The investment at a $178 million valuation was co-led by the oil giant’s investment arm and Aditum, with participation from Masarrah and Alyasra. The company has expanded its footprint across the GCC region, operating mainly in Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and the UAE.
The exact value of the investment has not been disclosed.

COFE is an enterprise AI and B2B SaaS platform for procurement and commerce, serving more than 1,000 businesses across 3,000 outlets in the GCC. Clients operate in various sectors, including food and beverage, hospitality, aviation, healthcare, education and retail.
COFE is planning to list on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul) in 2029.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria) seban.scaria@lseg.com

title: Saudi Aramco’s Wa’ed Ventures invests in COFE Tech ahead of IPO
